# Thread & Signal

Thread & Signal LLC is owned by Charles and Darian Russella in Kent, Ohio. It offers task automation, AI setup and testing, and practical team training. Contact: https://threadandsignal.com/contact/.

- [Home](https://threadandsignal.com/): We automate repetitive work.
- [Services Offered](https://threadandsignal.com/services/): Scope-based automation pricing and planning estimates in USD for AI setup and team training. Work and final price are agreed before starting.
- [Open-Source Dev](https://threadandsignal.com/open-source/): Free and open-source software is a core business practice. The five most-starred original public repositories refresh on a daily schedule, with the last successful update date shown.
- [About Us & Contact](https://threadandsignal.com/contact/): Charles's business automation background, Darian's systems and broadcast experience, both LinkedIn profiles, and an email draft addressed to both owners.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/crussella0129): Public repositories and current development.

Public projects are examples of work, not evidence of customer results or guaranteed performance. No full resumes or personal contact details are published.
